figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
FIG. 2. Organization of the monodictyphenone (mdp) gene cluster
in A. nidulans. Each arrow indicates the direction of transcription and
relative sizes of the open reading frames (ORFs) deduced from anal-
ysis of the nucleotide sequences. ORFs in black are genes involved in
monodictyphenone synthesis, and ORFs in gray are not required for
monodictyphenone synthesis.
FIG. 1. Structures of monodictyphenone (1), emodin (2), and emo-
din analogs (3 to 8).

figure_candidates.caption:
FIG. 3. Metabolite proﬁles of mdp cluster gene deletions with UV
at 276 nm. All strains carry nkuA, stcJ, and cclA. The y axis of each
proﬁle was at the same order of magnitude.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
FIG. 4. Metabolite proﬁles of single alcA promoter [alcA(p)-mdpE
or alcA(p)-mdpA] and dual alcA promoter [alcA(p)-mdpE alcA(p)-
mdpA] strains after 30 mM cyclopentanone induction for 48 or 72 h.
All strains carry nkuA and stcJ. The y axis of each proﬁle was at the
same order of magnitude.
